title: Metatranscriptomics Sample Preparation Protocol with ScriptSeq
author: Ed DeLong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.dib4am
materials: Pre-heat Elution Solution (or Nuclease-free water) to 95ºC.
Discard the flow-through. Reuse the collection tube.
Fragment RNA by incubation at 85 ºC for 5 minutes in thermocycler with heated lid. 00:05:00

On ice preare the cDNA synthesis master mix, volumes below are per rxn: cDNA synthesis premix 3 µl 100 mM DTT 0.5 µl StarScript Reverse Transcriptase 0.5 µl Total volume 4 µl Thermocycler setting found in guidelines. Use sytrofoam lid on thermocycler, not heated lid for C2-C3

On ice, prepare the terminal tagging premix: For each reaction, combine on ice: Terminal tagging premix 7.5 µl DNA polymerase 0.5 µl Total volume 8 µl Thermocycler setting found in guidelines. Thoroughly mix the terminal-tagging premix before use.
Gently mix by pipetting. Return each reaction to the thermocycler before proceeding to the next.
Thoroughly resuspend beads by pipetting 10 times.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary wash solutions and verify reagent age.

substeps.instruction: Add 21 ml of ACS grade 100% ethanol to Wash Solution 1 and mix well.
Add 40 ml of ACS grade 100% ethanol to Wash Solution 2/3 and mix well.
Verify that Acid-Phenol:Chloroform is not more than 6 months old.

steps.title: Lyse Cells on Filters
steps.instruction: Perform cell lysis on the filters using Lysis/Binding buffer and miRNA Homogenate Additive.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 2-ml screw-cap tube on ice.
Carefully remove and discard 300 µl RNAlater.
Add 750 µl Lysis/Binding buffer (use 1.5 mL if using sterivex filters) and vortex vigorously.
Add 75 µl miRNA Homogenate Additive (2M sodium acetate, pH 4) (use 150 µl if using sterivex filters) and vortex to mix.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Extract RNA via Acid-Phenol:Chloroform
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from the cell lysate using organic extraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 825 µl of lysate to a new non-stick RNase-free tube or 2 mL tube with o-ring (spin tubes to maximize recovery); if using sterivex filters, split lysate equally into two tubes.
Add 750 µl Acid-Phenol:Chloroform and vortex for 30-60 seconds.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at maximum 10,000 X g at room temperature (RT). Repeat if the interphase is not compact.
Carefully transfer the top aqueous phase to a fresh tube without disturbing the lower phase.

steps.title: Purify RNA using Filter Cartridge
steps.instruction: Bind and wash RNA using a filter cartridge system.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.25 volumes of RT 100% ethanol to the aqueous phase, mix well, and load onto a Filter Cartridge in the provided collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at 10,000 X g and discard flow-through.
Apply 700 µl miRNA Wash Solution 1, centrifuge for 10 seconds at 10,000 X g, and discard flow-through.
Apply 500 µl Wash Solution 2/3, centrifuge for 15 seconds at 10,000 X g, and discard flow-through.
Repeat the Wash Solution 2/3 step.
Centrifuge the cartridge in the tube for 1.5 minutes at 10,000 X g to remove residual fluid.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter using pre-heated solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Filter Cartridge into a fresh collection tube.
Apply 50 µl pre-heated (95 ºC) Elution Solution (0.1 mM EDTA) to the center of the filter.
Spin for 30 seconds at 10,000 X g.
Repeat the elution with another 50 µl of pre-heated (95 ºC) Elution Solution.

steps.title: Perform DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat heat block or hyb oven to 37 ºC.
Add 1/10th volume of DNase I buffer (~10 µl) and 2 µl DNase I (2U/µl), mix gently, and incubate at 37 ºC for 30 minutes.
If not proceeding immediately to RNeasy MinElute, add 0.1 volume (10 µl) of DNase inactivation reagent, mix, and incubate at RT for 2 minutes (flick tube occasionally).
Centrifuge for 1.5 minutes at 10,000 X g, transfer RNA to a fresh 0.5 ml non-stick RNase-free tube, and store at -70 ºC.

steps.title: Clean RNA with RNeasy MinElute
steps.instruction: Further purify the DNase-treated RNA using RNeasy MinElute columns.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat elution buffer or water to 40 ºC and add 4 volumes of 100% ethanol to buffer RPE.
Combine two 100 µl DNase-treated RNA samples in a 2 ml non-sticky RNase-free tube (~200 µl total).
Add 700 µl RLT buffer and mix by pipetting.
Add 500 µl 100% ethanol and mix thoroughly by pipetting (do not centrifuge).
Immediately load 700 µl onto an RNeasy MinElute Column, close gently, and centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥ 8,000 X g; discard flow-through.
Repeat loading for the remaining sample volume.
Transfer column to a new 2 ml collection tube, apply 500 µl buffer RPE, and centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥ 8,000 X g.
Add 500 µl of 80% ethanol to the column and centrifuge for 2 minutes at ≥ 8,000 X g; discard flow-through.
Transfer column to a new 2 ml collection tube, open the cap, and centrifuge at 12,000 X g for 5 minutes; discard flow-through.
Transfer column to a new 1.5 ml tube, apply 25 µl pre-heated nuclease-free water or RNA storage buffer to the center of the membrane, wait 2 minutes at RT, and centrifuge for 1 minute at 12,000 X g.
Repeat elution using 15 µl of water or buffer.
Store elutions at -80 ºC or quantify using Bioanalyzer (Agilent RNA 6000 Pico kit, range 0.05-5.0 ng/µl, dilute 1:10 and 1:100).

steps.title: Amplify rRNA for Probes
steps.instruction: Generate rRNA amplicons to be used as templates for antisense probes.

substeps.instruction: Order primers based on guidelines.

Perform PCR amplification of rRNA using 100 ng Bact 23S (35 cycles) or other primers (35 cycles) with Herculase II Fusion polymerase (Agilent 600675) in a 50 µl reaction: 10 µl 5X buffer, 1.25 µl dNTP (10mM), 1.25 µl F primer (10µM), 1.25 µl R primer (10µM), 1 µl Herculase pol, and H2O to 50 µl.
PCR Cycling: 95°C 2 min, then 35 cycles of (95°C 20 sec, 39°C 20 sec [or 55°C 20 sec for others], 72°C 2 min), finish with 72°C 3 min.
Purify PCR products using QIAquick PCR purification kit (elute in 50 µl). Note: Add 10 µl sodium acetate to PB+PCR mix to correct pH indicator to yellow.
Quantify DNA using Nanodrop (target >100 ng/µl).

steps.title: Synthesize Antisense rRNA Probes
steps.instruction: Perform in vitro transcription (IVT) to produce biotin-labeled aRNA probes.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate PCR amplicons to 250 ng/µl using Speedvac.

Prepare a 20 µl reaction: 250-500 ng PCR amplicons, 2 µl ATP (75 mM), 2 µl GTP (75 mM), 1.5 µl CTP (75 mM), 1.5 µl UTP (75 mM), 3.75 µl Biotin-11-CTP (10 mM), 3.75 µl Biotin-16-UTP (10 mM), 2 µl 10X buffer, 0.5 µl SUPERase•In RNase inhibitor, and 2 µl T7 RNA polymerase.
Mix reagents at room temperature (not on ice) in the listed order.
Incubate at 37 ºC for 4-6 hours (or overnight).
Add 1 µl DNase I and incubate at 37 ºC for 30 minutes.
Purify RNA using MEGAclear kit (elute in 50 µl elution solution).
Quantify using RiboGreen or Nanodrop and store probes at -80 ºC.

steps.title: Prepare and Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare biotin-binding beads for the hybridization step.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of vortexed beads to a 1.5 ml tube.
Wash 1: Bind beads to magnetic rack (~2 min), discard supernatant, resuspend in equal volume 0.1N NaOH, vortex, spin down, re-bind to magnet, and discard supernatant.
Wash 2: Repeat wash using 1X SSC buffer.
Wash 3: Repeat wash using 1X SSC buffer and leave beads in buffer on ice until hybridization is complete.

steps.title: Hybridize RNA to Probes
steps.instruction: Bind total RNA to antisense rRNA probes to enable subtraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µl reaction: total RNA (250-500 ng in <36.5 µl), 500-1000 ng aRNA 16S probe, 500-1000 ng aRNA 23S probe, 1 µl SUPERase•In RNase inhibitor, 2.5 µl 20X SSC buffer, 10 µl 100% Formamide, and nuclease-free water to 50 µl.
Incubate in thermal cycler: 5 min at 70 ºC, then ramp down to 25 ºC in 5 ºC increments (1 min per increment).
Remove and let sit at RT for 2-5 minutes.

steps.title: Capture and Remove rRNA
steps.instruction: Use magnetic beads to remove the probe-rRNA complexes from the sample.

substeps.instruction: Capture 400 µl pre-aliquoted beads on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, and remove beads from rack.
Dilute the hybridization reaction to 100 µl using 20% formamide in 1X SSC.
Add the 100 µl reaction to the dried beads and incubate at RT for 10 minutes (flick occasionally).
Quick spin and capture beads on magnetic rack (2-3 min).
Transfer non-rRNA supernatant to a 1.5 ml tube using a P200 pipettor.
Resuspend beads with 100 µl 1X SSC, capture on magnet, and transfer supernatant to the same 1.5 ml tube (total 200 µl).

steps.title: Purify Subtracted RNA
steps.instruction: Remove formamide and purify the rRNA-depleted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Purify the 200 µl subtracted RNA using RNeasy MinElute kit; elute in 15 µl and 5 µl pre-heated to 50 ºC (combine elutions).
Optional: Run 1 µl of purified RNA (diluted 1:10 and 1:100) on Bioanalyzer to confirm subtraction.
Store RNA at -80 ºC.
If needed, speedvac the subtracted RNA to a maximum volume of 9 µl.

steps.title: Fragment RNA and Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the RNA and perform first-strand cDNA synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Assemble reaction in 0.2 mL PCR tube: rRNA-subtracted RNA, RNA fragmentation solution, 1.0 µl cDNA synthesis primer, and nuclease-free water to 12 µl.
Stop fragmentation by placing on ice.
Add 4 µl of cDNA synthesis master mix and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 25 ºC for 5 minutes, then 42 ºC for 20 minutes.
Cool to 37 ºC and pause thermocycler.
Add 1.0 µl Finishing solution to each reaction and incubate at 37 ºC for 10 minutes.
Incubate at 95 ºC for 3 minutes, then cool to 25 ºC.

steps.title: Perform Terminal Tagging
steps.instruction: Add terminal tags to the cDNA for subsequent PCR amplification.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 µl of terminal tagging master mix to each reaction.
Incubate at 25 ºC for 15 minutes.
Incubate at 95 ºC for 3 minutes, then cool to 4 ºC on ice or in thermocycler.

steps.title: Purify Di-tagged cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the tagged cDNA using AmpureXP beads (1.8X purification).

substeps.instruction: Warm Ampure beads to RT for 30 minutes.
Prepare 400 µl fresh 80% ethanol at RT.
Add 45 µl beads to the di-tagged cDNA and mix by pipetting 10 times.
Transfer to 1.5 mL tube and incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until liquid is clear; discard supernatant.
Perform two ethanol washes: add 200 µl 80% ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and discard supernatant.
Air-dry on magnetic stand for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 24.5 µl nuclease-free water, remove from stand, and incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until liquid clears.
Transfer 22.5 µl supernatant to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube and place on ice.

steps.title: Amplify Library via PCR
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to amplify the di-tagged cDNA library.

substeps.instruction: Assemble PCR reaction: 22.5 µl di-tagged cDNA, 25 µl FailSafe PCR Premix E, 1 µl Forward PCR primer, 1 µl Reverse or ScriptSeq index primer, and 0.5 µl FailSafe PCR Enzyme (1.25 U) (Total 50 µl).
Perform PCR: Denature at 95 ºC for 1 minute; 12-15 cycles of (95 ºC 30 sec, 55 ºC 30 sec, 68 ºC 3 min); finish with 68 ºC for 7 minutes; cool to 4 ºC.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product to remove primer-dimers using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Warm Ampure beads to RT for 30 minutes and prepare 400 µl fresh 80% ethanol.
Add 50 µl beads to the amplified library and mix by pipetting 10 times.
Transfer 100 µl volume to 1.5 mL tube and incubate at RT for 15 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes; discard supernatant.
Perform two ethanol washes: add 200 µl 80% ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and discard supernatant.
Air-dry on magnetic stand for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 20 µl nuclease-free water, remove from stand, and incubate at RT for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until liquid clears.
Transfer the supernatant (RNA-Seq library) to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify and Sequence Library
steps.instruction: Analyze the final library and prepare for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Make 1:10 and 1:100 dilutions for Bioanalyzer analysis of average library size.
Perform PicoGreen for accurate quantification of library concentration.
Pool samples (checking compatible indices) and sequence via MiSeq (recommended 6 pM) or NextSeq (recommended 1.0 pM).
